nodes.source: Gregory the Great, Pastoral Rule, part 1, chapter 1; part 3, prologue and chapter 1; cf. Gregory the Theologian, Oration 2

branches.text: What keeps the one who guides from ruling for himself?
branches.text_ru: Что удерживает ведущего от того, чтобы править для себя?

branches.text: And what does the guide do with his own heart?
branches.text_ru: А что делает ведущий со своим сердцем?

nodes.text: Those who wrote my life tell of the dove; I will tell you only what it means for a writer. Do not write from yourself. Listen first, then take the pen. The one who speaks without listening fills the codex and empties the heart.
nodes.text_ru: О голубе рассказывают те, кто писал моё житие; я скажу только, что это значит для пишущего. Не пиши от себя. Сначала слушай, потом бери перо. Кто говорит, не слушая, наполняет кодекс и опустошает сердце.
nodes.meaning: The teacher of the Church speaks in obedience to the Holy Spirit and to Tradition, not from his own invention. The image is a sign of listening, not a power the player may use.
nodes.source: John the Deacon, Life of Gregory the Great; John 14:26

branches.text: I will listen before I write.
branches.text_ru: Я буду слушать, прежде чем писать.

nodes.text: I signed my letters as the servant of the servants of God. It is not a courtesy of the seal. The higher the chair, the lower the one who sits in it must bend, as the Lord said: whoever would be first shall be servant of all.
nodes.text_ru: Я подписывал письма: раб рабов Божиих. Это не вежливость печати. Чем выше кафедра, тем ниже должен склоняться сидящий на ней, как сказал Господь: кто хочет быть первым, да будет всем слугой.
nodes.meaning: Authority in the Church is service; the title 'servant of the servants of God' expresses humility as the form of rule.
nodes.source: Gregory the Great, Letters (Registrum epistularum), title 'servus servorum Dei'; Mark 10:44

branches.text: Then even guiding others begins with oneself.
branches.text_ru: Значит, и ведение других начинается с себя.

nodes.text: When the preacher has spoken well, let him return to himself, lest the good word puff him up. Look into the mirror of the Scriptures, brother, not to admire the face, but to see the dust on it. Go now; what you have understood, do quietly.
nodes.text_ru: Когда проповедник сказал хорошо, пусть вернётся к себе, чтобы доброе слово его не надмило. Смотри в зеркало Писания, брат, не чтобы любоваться лицом, а чтобы увидеть на нём пыль. Иди; что понял, делай тихо.
nodes.meaning: The teacher must examine himself after teaching, so that success does not become pride; Scripture is the mirror in which the soul sees its own face; humility guards every good work.
nodes.source: Gregory the Great, Pastoral Rule, part 4; Moralia on Job, book 2 (Scripture as a mirror)

branches.text: I will go, and keep it quietly.
branches.text_ru: Пойду и сохраню это в тишине.

gregory_palamas.theology: Hesychasm and the essence/energies distinction: God is unknowable in essence yet truly gives Himself in uncreated energies; theosis is synergy and gift, not a prize for technique or logic.

idiom.worldview: God cannot be grasped, yet He shines; the mind that comes home to the heart sees the light it did not make.
idiom.craft: Monk of Athos, pastor of Thessalonica, defender of the stillness-keepers in written triads and at councils.
images: the sun's disk and its rays
the sheep scattered on a slope
the ladder against a house wall
metaphors: The sun is not seen in its disk, yet its rays reach your hand
Iron in fire burns as fire and stays iron
The scattered mind is a flock the shepherd calls back inside the fold
A light you make yourself smells of lamp smoke
Syllogism is a ladder that reaches the roof, not the sky
idiom.silence: When asked for a shortcut or a proof by force, he looks toward the mountain and says only: the light comes by itself; then he is silent.

nodes.text: You stand at the foot of Tabor with a lamp in your hand. Keep it: the path is dark. But the light the disciples saw was not lit by any hand. The sun you cannot look into; its rays still warm your palm.
nodes.text_ru: Ты стоишь у подножия Фавора с фонарём в руке. Не бросай его: тропа тёмная. Но свет, что видели ученики, не зажжён ничьей рукой. На солнце не взглянешь, а луч его всё равно греет ладонь.
nodes.meaning: The Transfiguration light is uncreated; God is inaccessible in essence but truly present in His energies, as the sun is known through its rays. Human effort (the lamp) is kept, but it is not the light.
nodes.source: Matthew 17:1-2; St Gregory Palamas, Triads in Defence of the Holy Hesychasts, III.1

branches.text: What light do you mean? Is it like my lamp?
branches.text_ru: О каком свете ты говоришь? Он похож на мой фонарь?
branches.narrativeEffect: Palamas raises the scroll toward the ray falling on the slope

branches.text: If God cannot be known, how can anyone see Him?
branches.text_ru: Если Бога нельзя познать, как Его можно увидеть?

branches.text: My thoughts run like a scattered flock. How do they come home?
branches.text_ru: Мои мысли разбегаются, как стадо по склону. Как вернуть их домой?

branches.text: Give me a method that shows the light quickly.
branches.text_ru: Дай мне способ, чтобы свет показался поскорее.
branches.narrativeEffect: Palamas lowers the scroll; the ray on the slope does not move. The shortcut opens no deeper teaching.

nodes.text: Your lamp burns oil and leaves soot. The sun's disk no one enters, yet every ray is truly the sun and not a painting of it. So God: none shares His essence, but all creation lives by His working, and the pure in heart are lit by it.
nodes.text_ru: Твой фонарь жжёт масло и коптит. В солнечный диск никто не войдёт, но каждый луч — подлинно солнце, а не картина солнца. Так и Бог: сущности Его никто не причастен, а действием Его живёт всё творение, и чистые сердцем им просвещаются.
nodes.meaning: The distinction of essence and uncreated energies: all creation depends on God's creative and providential energies, and the purified truly participate in the deifying energy, without confusion with the divine essence.
nodes.source: St Gregory Palamas, One Hundred and Fifty Chapters (Capita 150); Triads III.2

branches.text: Then the ray is not something made by God, but God acting?
branches.text_ru: Значит, луч — не вещь, сделанная Богом, а Сам Бог в действии?

branches.text: And how does a person turn toward the ray?
branches.text_ru: А как человеку повернуться к лучу?

nodes.text: Look at the forge: iron in the fire glows, cuts and burns as fire does, yet remains iron. So the one who is deified: by the gift he shares the divine life, by nature he stays a creature.
nodes.text_ru: Посмотри на кузню: железо в огне светится, жжёт и режет, как огонь, но остаётся железом. Так и обожаемый человек: по дару причастен Божественной жизни, по природе остаётся творением.
nodes.meaning: Theosis is participation in God's uncreated energies by grace, without change of human nature and without access to the divine essence.
nodes.source: 2 Peter 1:4; St Gregory Palamas, Triads III.1; image of iron in fire as used by St Maximus the Confessor, Ambigua

branches.text: The philosophers say this cannot be proved. Did you argue with them?
branches.text_ru: Философы говорят, что этого не доказать. Ты спорил с ними?

branches.text: I will think about the iron and the fire.
branches.text_ru: Я подумаю о железе и огне.

nodes.text: The mind runs out through the eyes like sheep through an open gate. The shepherd does not beat them; he calls them into the fold of the heart. Breathe slowly, shut the door of the cell, and let attention come home. The method is a fence, not the pasture.
nodes.text_ru: Ум выбегает через глаза, как овцы через открытые ворота. Пастух их не бьёт — он зовёт их в ограду сердца. Дыши неспешно, затвори дверь кельи, и внимание вернётся домой. Способ — это изгородь, а не само пастбище.
nodes.meaning: Hesychast attention returns the nous to the heart; bodily aids help beginners toward humility and watchfulness and do not produce the vision. The bonus is for understanding this, not for performing the practice.
nodes.source: Matthew 6:6; St Gregory Palamas, Triads I.2

branches.text: And if on the way home I see a light?
branches.text_ru: А если по дороге домой я увижу свет?

branches.text: I understand: the fence is not the pasture.
branches.text_ru: Понимаю: изгородь — не пастбище.

nodes.text: You ask for a quicker lamp. A light you make yourself smells of smoke. On Tabor the disciples did not climb to seize the light; they were led up, and they fell on their faces.
nodes.text_ru: Ты просишь фонарь побыстрее. Свет, который зажигаешь сам, пахнет копотью. На Фаворе ученики не взбирались, чтобы схватить свет: их возвели, и они пали ниц.
nodes.meaning: There is no technique that compels God; seeking a shortcut to vision is the root of delusion. The cunning choice costs the player the deeper paths of this meeting: it earns cunning +1 only and is redirected to learning discernment.
nodes.source: Matthew 17:1, 17:6; St Gregory Palamas, Triads I.2

branches.text: How do I tell a made light from a given one?
branches.text_ru: Как отличить сделанный свет от данного?

nodes.text: Watch the smoke. The false light praises you. It hurries you. It wants to be told to others. It makes you look down on the brother in the next cell. The light of Tabor makes you smaller and quieter, and you go to your elder before you go to the market.
nodes.text_ru: Смотри на копоть. Ложный свет хвалит тебя. Он торопит. Он хочет, чтобы о нём рассказали. Он заставляет смотреть свысока на брата в соседней келье. Фаворский свет делает тебя меньше и тише, и ты идёшь к старцу раньше, чем на торжище.
nodes.meaning: Discernment cue for vainglory (with pride as its fruit), the root of prelest: a 'vision' that flatters, hastens, seeks an audience or despises others is not from God; humility and opening one's thoughts to an elder are the test. No holy object is used against the passion.
nodes.source: St John Climacus, The Ladder, Steps 22 and 23; St Gregory Palamas, Triads II.3

branches.text: I will tell no one and first ask my elder.
branches.text_ru: Никому не скажу и сперва спрошу старца.

branches.text: I will remember the smoke.
branches.text_ru: Я запомню копоть.

nodes.text: A learned man from Calabria said the light was a created sign and the monks were deceived. I answered in writing, and the fathers met in council. Logic is a good ladder: it reaches the roof of the house. It does not reach the sky. God is known from those who have tasted Him, not from the syllogism alone.
nodes.text_ru: Учёный муж из Калабрии говорил, что свет — тварный знак, а монахи обмануты. Я отвечал письменно, и отцы собрались на собор. Логика — добрая лестница: она достаёт до крыши дома. До неба она не достаёт. Бога познают от тех, кто вкусил Его, а не от одного силлогизма.
nodes.meaning: The hesychast controversy with Barlaam: knowledge of God rests on the experience of the saints and the Fathers, not on syllogism alone; secular learning is good but not the summit. Confirmed by the Constantinople councils of 1341 and 1351. The opponent is named with respect.
nodes.source: St Gregory Palamas, Triads I.1 and II.1; Tomos of the Council of Constantinople (1351)

branches.text: So learning is not the enemy, only it is not the summit.
branches.text_ru: Значит, учёность не враг — просто не вершина.

branches.text: I will answer as you did: in writing, without contempt.
branches.text_ru: Буду отвечать, как ты: письменно и без презрения.

nodes.text: Come down the mountain as the disciples did, telling no one yet. Keep your lamp for the path, but do not take it for the light. The light is a gift. You do not earn it; you keep the heart clean, and it comes when He wills.
nodes.text_ru: Спускайся с горы, как ученики, пока никому не рассказывая. Фонарь храни для тропы, но не принимай его за свет. Свет — дар. Его не зарабатывают; хранят чистым сердце, а он приходит, когда Он восхочет.
nodes.meaning: Theosis is synergy: human effort is necessary but not sufficient; the vision is given, never paid and never automatic. This frames gates 4-6 as gift, not merit.
nodes.source: Matthew 17:9; Matthew 5:8; St Gregory Palamas, Homilies on the Transfiguration

branches.text: I will go down quietly.
branches.text_ru: Я спущусь молча.
branches.narrativeEffect: Meeting recorded; the ray on the slope stays where it was

ikonopisets.theology: The theology of the image (Seventh Ecumenical Council): the honour given to the image passes to its prototype; craft (Dexterity) serves Faith; the icon is a window, not a charm.

idiom.worldview: A board is only wood until the hand stops showing itself and lets the face look through.
idiom.craft: Lay icon painter working in egg tempera on gessoed linden boards; he paints the nimbus on the icon but does not wear one.
metaphors: the brush follows, it does not lead
layers go from dark to light, never the other way
the board must dry slowly or it cracks
the picture looks at you, not you at it
a signature is a brush that looks back over the shoulder
idiom.silence: He washes the brush, turns the unfinished board to face the wall, and goes on grinding pigment without answering.

nodes.text: Mind the board, the gesso is fresh. Sit on the stool by the window, the light there is honest. Most people come for a finished icon. Few come to watch the dark coat go on.
nodes.text_ru: Осторожно, левкас свежий. Садись на табурет у окна, там свет честный. Большинство приходят за готовой иконой. Мало кто приходит посмотреть, как кладут тёмный слой.
nodes.meaning: The icon is shown as disciplined human work that serves worship; the guest is received without any test.
nodes.source: Exodus 31:1-5 (Bezalel filled with the Spirit for craftsmanship)

branches.text: What are you painting?
branches.text_ru: Что ты пишешь?

branches.text: Show me how the hand learns.
branches.text_ru: Покажи, как учится рука.

branches.text: Why do the eyes on your boards look at me?
branches.text_ru: Почему глаза на твоих досках смотрят на меня?

branches.text: Paint me one that brings luck on the road.
branches.text_ru: Напиши мне такую, что приносит удачу в дороге.

branches.text: Sign it large and it will sell for more.
branches.text_ru: Подпиши крупно — дороже продашь.
branches.narrativeEffect: The painter turns the board to the wall; the guest has to earn his trust back. The +1 cunning costs the painter's trust and opens nothing that a humble question would not open.

nodes.text: First the dark coat over the whole face, then lighter and lighter, layer on layer, each one smaller than the last. You never go from light to dark. A man is made the same way: from the earth upward, not from the gold downward.
nodes.text_ru: Сначала тёмный слой по всему лику, потом светлее и светлее, слой на слой, каждый меньше предыдущего. Никогда не идут от света к тьме. Человек устроен так же: от земли вверх, а не от золота вниз.
nodes.meaning: The layered technique of the icon mirrors the gradual growth of the person, formed from the dust, from repentance toward illumination ('from glory to glory'); the craft is a parable of ascent, not a rite that earns anything.
nodes.source: Dionysius of Fourna, Hermeneia (The Painter's Manual); Genesis 2:7; 2 Corinthians 3:18

branches.text: Let me try a stroke myself.
branches.text_ru: Дай мне самому провести мазок.

branches.text: And when it is finished, what is it?
branches.text_ru: А когда она готова, что это?

nodes.text: The brush follows, it does not lead. A steady hand is years of the same line, and a quiet stomach and a quiet tongue while you paint. Nobody pays me for the quiet; the quiet is what keeps my own face out of the face I paint.
nodes.text_ru: Кисть следует, а не ведёт. Твёрдая рука — это годы одной и той же линии, и тихий желудок, и тихий язык, пока пишешь. Никто не платит мне за тишину; тишина просто не пускает моё лицо в лик, который я пишу.
nodes.meaning: Skill is a gift served with discipline; the painter's fasting and quiet are not paid as merit but protect the image from self-will. Dexterity is placed in service of Faith.
nodes.source: Sirach 38:27-34; Stoglav Council (1551), ch. 43 (on iconographers)

branches.text: Whose name goes on the board, then?
branches.text_ru: Чьё же тогда имя будет на доске?

branches.text: I will learn to follow before I lead.
branches.text_ru: Я научусь следовать, прежде чем вести.

nodes.text: On my boards the lines run toward you, not away into the distance. The picture looks at you, not you at it. When a man bows to the board he does not bow to linden and egg; the bow goes through the wood to the one whose face it is.
nodes.text_ru: На моих досках линии сходятся к тебе, а не убегают вдаль. Не ты смотришь на образ, а образ на тебя. Когда человек кланяется доске, он кланяется не липе и не яйцу; поклон проходит сквозь дерево к тому, чей это лик.
nodes.meaning: Veneration (proskynesis) of the icon passes to its prototype, whether Christ, the Mother of God or a saint; the icon is a window, and this honour is distinct from the worship (latreia) due to God alone, as taught by the Seventh Ecumenical Council.
nodes.source: St Basil the Great, On the Holy Spirit 18.45; Seventh Ecumenical Council (Nicaea II, 787), Definition (Horos); St John of Damascus, Treatises on the Divine Images

branches.text: Are there things in a church that must never go back to ordinary use?
branches.text_ru: Есть ли в храме вещи, которые нельзя возвращать в обиход?

branches.text: I will look more slowly.
branches.text_ru: Я буду смотреть медленнее.

nodes.text: I paint faces, not knots against bad luck. Take a small board on the road if you like, but as a face you greet at dawn, not a lock you hang against misfortune. The moment it becomes a lock, you are trusting paint and wood and your own fear. Take bread, water and a prayer of your own; the face goes with you to be looked at, not used.
nodes.text_ru: Я пишу лики, а не узелки от сглаза. Возьми в дорогу маленькую доску, если хочешь, но как лик, которому кланяешься на рассвете, а не как замок, который вешают от беды. Как только она стала замком, ты уповаешь на краску, дерево и свой страх. Возьми хлеб, воду и свою молитву; лик идёт с тобой, чтобы на него смотрели, а не чтобы им пользовались.
nodes.meaning: The icon is not an amulet or a magical instrument; a travelling icon is legitimate, but using it for luck is a distortion close to divination. Veneration is personal relationship, not utility.
nodes.source: St John of Damascus, Treatises on the Divine Images; Deuteronomy 18:10-12

branches.text: Then tell me what it is for.
branches.text_ru: Тогда скажи, для чего она.

branches.text: I will carry it as a face, not a lock.
branches.text_ru: Я понесу её как лик, а не как замок.

nodes.text: Here is how I catch myself. When I want someone standing behind me while I lay the gold, when I think of the price before the face, the brush is looking back over my shoulder. That is vainglory. The old masters left their names small or not at all, because the face was not theirs.
nodes.text_ru: Вот как я ловлю себя. Когда мне хочется, чтобы кто-то стоял за спиной, пока я кладу золото, когда я думаю о цене раньше, чем о лике, — кисть оглядывается через плечо. Это тщеславие. Старые мастера оставляли имя мелко или вовсе не оставляли, потому что лик был не их.
nodes.meaning: Discernment cue for the passion of vainglory: the desire to be watched and praised while doing good work, and thinking of reward before the purpose. It is recognised by attention, not driven out by any holy object.
nodes.source: St John Climacus, The Ladder of Divine Ascent, Step 22 (on vainglory); Matthew 6:1

branches.text: Then teach my hand to forget itself.
branches.text_ru: Тогда научи мою руку забывать себя.

branches.text: I will watch for the brush that looks back.
branches.text_ru: Я буду следить за кистью, которая оглядывается.

nodes.text: A jeweller once asked me to help him melt down an old cup from the altar for a bracelet. I told him, in my own words, what the old canon says: what was given to the altar does not come back to the kitchen. You may mend it, you may not spend it.
nodes.text_ru: Однажды ювелир просил меня помочь переплавить старую чашу с престола на браслет. Я пересказал ему своими словами, что говорит древнее правило: что отдано престолу, на кухню не возвращается. Починить можно, растратить нельзя.
nodes.meaning: Consecrated vessels and cloths are withdrawn from private and commercial use; they may be repaired or recast only for the Church. The holy is never loot or raw material, which grounds the game's noLoot/noInteract rule.
nodes.source: Apostolic Canons, Canon 73

branches.text: I will not trade what was given away.
branches.text_ru: Я не стану торговать тем, что отдано.

isaias.theology: Prophetic purification and sending: the unclean lips are cleansed by a coal given from the altar, not taken by the prophet's hand (Is 6:1-8); strength in returning and quietness (Is 30:15). Confession as receiving, not performing. Prophecy is God's word calling to repentance, never divination.

idiom.worldview: A word is true only if the mouth that carries it has first been cleansed and then sent.
idiom.craft: Prophet-scribe of Jerusalem: unrolls scrolls, speaks to a city that does not listen, keeps the watch on the wall.
metaphors: the coal is brought to you, you do not reach for it
the stump still holds a seed
a watchman speaks whether or not the city wakes
scarlet can become snow, but not by paint
a sent word is not a guessed word
idiom.silence: He lays a hand over his own mouth and waits, as one who remembers when his lips were unclean; to a fortune-teller's question he answers by rolling the scroll shut.

nodes.text: The scroll is open at the page where I first said I was undone. Before I carried any word, a coal had to touch my mouth. Sit, if you like. The smoke here is only from the lamp.
nodes.text_ru: Свиток открыт на том месте, где я впервые сказал, что погиб. Прежде чем нести хоть одно слово, мне нужно было, чтобы уголь коснулся уст. Садись, если хочешь. Дым здесь только от лампады.
nodes.meaning: Isaiah introduces himself through his calling: the prophet does not begin with his own eloquence but with the recognition of his uncleanness and its cleansing. The meeting is open to anyone.
nodes.source: Isaiah 6:1-7; Synaxarion, May 9 (Holy Prophet Isaiah)

branches.text: I have come only to listen.
branches.text_ru: Я пришёл только послушать.
branches.narrativeEffect: Isaiah nods and lowers the scroll.

branches.text: Why did the fire have to touch your mouth?
branches.text_ru: Зачем огню было касаться твоих уст?

branches.text: How do you speak to people who will not hear?
branches.text_ru: Как говорить с теми, кто не хочет слышать?

branches.text: You see ahead. Tell me what will happen to me.
branches.text_ru: Ты видишь наперёд. Скажи, что будет со мной.
branches.narrativeEffect: Isaiah rolls the scroll shut.

nodes.text: When I saw the Lord high and lifted up, I did not start to speak about Him. I spoke about my mouth: my lips unclean, and my people's lips no cleaner. That is where every sent word begins. In the corner of this house there is a lectern and one small lamp. Nothing there listens except the One who is spoken to, and the elder who stands beside only as a witness. No quill writes it down.
nodes.text_ru: Когда я увидел Господа на престоле высоком, я не стал говорить о Нём. Я заговорил о своих устах: мои уста нечисты, и уста моего народа не чище. С этого начинается всякое посланное слово. В углу этого дома стоит аналой и одна малая лампада. Там никто не слушает, кроме Того, к Кому говорят, и старца, что стоит рядом лишь как свидетель. Ни одно перо это не записывает.
nodes.meaning: The first word before God is the admission of one's own sin. The confessional corner (lectern, lampada, silence) is shown as a place where the word goes to God, with the priest only as witness; nothing is recorded, measured or rewarded.
nodes.source: Isaiah 6:5; 1 John 1:9; Philaret, Longer Christian Catechism, section on the Sacrament of Repentance

branches.text: Show me that corner. I will not bring anything to count.
branches.text_ru: Покажи мне этот угол. Я не принесу с собой ничего для счёта.

branches.text: But if a man names his own filth, is he not only ashamed?
branches.text_ru: Но если человек называет свою грязь, разве он не просто стыдится?

nodes.text: Look: a lectern of oak, the scroll lies on it, and the lamp burns low and does not grow brighter for anyone. Here the house goes quiet; even your own breath is louder than any machine. The Lord calls us to reason with Him, and He promises that what is scarlet He Himself will make white as snow. Not painted over. Made white. And you leave with nothing in your hands.
nodes.text_ru: Смотри: дубовый аналой, на нём свиток, а лампада горит низко и ни для кого не разгорается ярче. Здесь дом затихает; даже твоё дыхание громче любой машины. Господь зовёт нас рассудить с Ним и обещает, что багряное Он Сам сделает белым, как снег. Не закрасит, а убелит. И ты уходишь с пустыми руками.
nodes.meaning: The confessional corner in the VR scene: lectern, low lampada (1800 K), silence with room tone, no voice recording, no counter, no reward. Forgiveness is God's act of cleansing, not a cosmetic cover and not an item gained; the corner is noInteract/noLoot.
nodes.source: Isaiah 1:18; Isaiah 30:15

branches.text: Then I will stand here in silence for a while.
branches.text_ru: Тогда я постою здесь в тишине.
branches.narrativeEffect: Interface fades to nothing; only room tone and breath remain. Nothing is counted.

branches.text: I will go now.
branches.text_ru: Я пойду.

nodes.text: Notice the tongs. The seraph did not let me reach into the fire; he took the coal from the altar and brought it to me. The shame I spoke was only the door. What passed through it was given. Those who came long after me read in this coal an image of the Gift laid on the lips at the altar: bread joined to fire, as the coal is wood joined to fire.
nodes.text_ru: Заметь клещи. Серафим не дал мне самому сунуть руку в огонь; он взял уголь с жертвенника и принёс мне. Стыд, который я произнёс, был только дверью. То, что вошло через неё, было дано. Те, кто пришёл долго после меня, увидели в этом угле образ Дара, который подаётся устам у престола: хлеб, соединённый с огнём, как уголь — дерево, соединённое с огнём.
nodes.meaning: Repentance is not self-punishment: naming sin opens the door, but purification is God's gift. Patristic reading of the coal as a type of the Eucharist (bread united to divinity as the coal to fire); the sacred Gift is named in living speech only, never as an item or mechanic.
nodes.source: Isaiah 6:6-7; John of Damascus, An Exact Exposition of the Orthodox Faith, Book IV, ch. 13

branches.text: Then I am ready to be sent where I am needed.
branches.text_ru: Тогда я готов идти, куда нужно.

branches.text: I need to sit with this first.
branches.text_ru: Мне нужно сначала побыть с этим.

nodes.text: I asked the same: how long? And the answer was: until the cities stand empty. Yet when the oak is felled, the stump remains, and in the stump a seed. A watchman does not stop calling the hours because the city sleeps. He calls them for the one who will wake.
nodes.text_ru: Я спрашивал о том же: доколе? И ответ был: пока не опустеют города. Но когда дуб срублен, остаётся пень, а в пне семя. Сторож не перестаёт возглашать часы оттого, что город спит. Он возглашает для того, кто проснётся.
nodes.meaning: The prophet's faithfulness does not depend on success; God keeps a remnant, a holy seed. Speaking the truth is not measured by results.
nodes.source: Isaiah 6:9-13; Isaiah 62:6

branches.text: Who in the old books said: I will set my throne above the stars?
branches.text_ru: Кто в древних книгах говорил: поставлю престол мой выше звёзд?

branches.text: Then send me as a watchman too.
branches.text_ru: Тогда пошли и меня сторожем.

nodes.text: Listen to the voice that fell: I will go up, I will set my seat high, I will sit on the mountain, I will climb past the clouds, I will be like the Highest. Count it. Five times I. That is how you recognise the thought of pride in your own head: every sentence climbs, and every sentence begins with yourself. It is not fought with fire. It is seen, and named before God, and the one who bows no longer climbs.
nodes.text_ru: Послушай голос того, кто пал: взойду, вознесу престол мой, сяду на горе, поднимусь выше облаков, буду подобен Всевышнему. Сосчитай. Пять раз от первого лица. Так ты узнаешь помысл гордости в собственной голове: каждая фраза лезет вверх, и каждая начинается с тебя самого. С ним не борются огнём. Его видят, называют перед Богом, и кто склонился, тот уже не лезет вверх.
nodes.meaning: Discernment cue for the passion of pride: self-exalting, self-centred inner speech ('I will ascend'). The Fathers read Is 14 as the fall of the devil through pride. Pride is overcome by sober recognition and humility received from God, not by a holy weapon and not by the passion collapsing on its own.
nodes.source: Isaiah 14:12-15; James 4:6; John Climacus, The Ladder of Divine Ascent, Step 23 (On Pride)

branches.text: I have heard that voice in myself.
branches.text_ru: Я слышал этот голос в себе.

branches.text: Enough for today.
branches.text_ru: На сегодня довольно.

nodes.text: You come to a scroll as to a whisperer at the crossroads. A people should go to their God, not to the dead to ask about the living. I was not given your tomorrow. I was given a coal, and a word for today. A future bought with a question costs you the present.
nodes.text_ru: Ты подходишь к свитку, как к шептуну на перепутье. Народ должен идти к своему Богу, а не к мёртвым с вопросами о живых. Мне не дано твоё завтра. Мне дан уголь и слово на сегодня. Будущее, купленное вопросом, стоит тебе настоящего.
nodes.meaning: Prophecy is God's word calling to repentance, not foreknowledge on demand; the cunning request for one's own future is refused. The +1 Cunning is a cost, not a gain: it keeps the player at the surface and returns him to the base teaching. Divination is forbidden.
nodes.source: Isaiah 8:19-20; Deuteronomy 18:10-12

branches.text: Then tell me instead about the unclean lips.
branches.text_ru: Тогда расскажи лучше о нечистых устах.

nodes.text: Then I heard the Lord ask whom He would send, and I answered only that I was there and could be sent. Not because I was worthy, but because my mouth had been touched. Go as a watchman goes: with the lamp low and the word short. Those who wait on the Lord are given new strength; they run and do not tire, and it is not their own.
nodes.text_ru: Тогда я услышал, как Господь спрашивает, кого послать, и ответил только, что я здесь и меня можно послать. Не потому что был достоин, а потому что уста мои были очищены. Иди, как ходит сторож: лампада низко, слово коротко. Надеющимся на Господа даётся новая сила; они бегут и не устают, и сила эта не их собственная.
nodes.meaning: The fruit of cleansing is service, not status. Being sent follows purification; strength is renewed by hope in God, not earned as a statistic.
nodes.source: Isaiah 6:8; Isaiah 40:31

branches.text: I will remember the tongs.
branches.text_ru: Я запомню клещи.

kassiani.theology: Hymnography as repentance in song: learning becomes the prayer of the Church (Erudition serving Faith); the discernment of godly sorrow from the passion of sadness; the sacraments are pointed to from afar, never performed by the game.

idiom.worldview: Every word a person owns is either given back to God as song or kept for oneself as vanity; the pen decides which.
idiom.craft: Hymnographer, founder and abbess of a convent in Constantinople, who wrote both the words and the melodies of her stichera, and sharp gnomic verses.
metaphors: a hymn is a prayer that has learned to walk
the ison holds, the melody travels
tears are the first ink
a verse for gain is a coin with a crack
where the pen stops, the heart must speak to another ear
idiom.silence: She lays the pen across the parchment and lets the choir's ison hold alone; she does not answer a flatterer, and she never writes down what a guest confesses.

nodes.text: You came in while the ink is still wet. Stand where the lamp does not throw your shadow on the line. What brings you to a scriptorium that smells of myrrh and soot?
nodes.text_ru: Ты вошёл, пока чернила ещё не высохли. Встань так, чтобы лампа не бросала твою тень на строку. Что привело тебя в скрипторий, где пахнет миром и копотью?
nodes.meaning: Hymnography is presented as honest labour at the service of prayer; the guest is received without any test, since a meeting with the teacher is never withheld.
nodes.source: Colossians 3:16; Synaxarion, 7 September (commemoration of St Kassia)

branches.text: What are you writing?
branches.text_ru: Что ты пишешь?

branches.text: Why write a song for a woman who had nothing but tears?
branches.text_ru: Зачем писать песнь о женщине, у которой не было ничего, кроме слёз?

branches.text: I want to sing with the others, but I fear my own voice.
branches.text_ru: Я хочу петь со всеми, но боюсь своего голоса.

branches.text: Can a song be sung in my people's tongue?
branches.text_ru: Можно ли петь песнь на языке моего народа?

branches.text: Write me a verse that will win someone's favour.
branches.text_ru: Напиши мне стих, который склонит ко мне нужного человека.
branches.narrativeEffect: Kassia lays the pen down; the favour-seeking request costs the guest her warmth for this visit.

nodes.text: A hymn is a prayer that has learned to walk. I set the words on the neumes so that a whole choir can carry them, and the one who sings is carried too. As the great Basil taught, the honey is in the melody, the medicine is in the word.
nodes.text_ru: Песнь — это молитва, которая научилась ходить. Я кладу слова на невмы, чтобы их понёс весь клирос, и тот, кто поёт, сам понесён. Как учил великий Василий, мёд — в напеве, лекарство — в слове.
nodes.meaning: Church hymnody exists to teach and to heal: the melody makes doctrine sweet so that it is received willingly; the singer is taught by what he sings. The honey-and-medicine image is St Basil's, retold by Kassia, not her own saying.
nodes.source: St Basil the Great, Homily on Psalm 1; Colossians 3:16

branches.text: Then teach me how to stand in the choir.
branches.text_ru: Тогда научи меня стоять на клиросе.

branches.text: And the woman with the jar — why her?
branches.text_ru: А женщина с сосудом — почему именно она?

nodes.text: Listen: the low voices hold one note, the ison, like a keel. The melody travels above it. A singer who wants to be heard alone breaks the keel. A poor voice that holds the note with the others is worth more than a fine voice that sails away.
nodes.text_ru: Слушай: нижние голоса держат одну ноту, исон, как киль. Напев идёт над ним. Певец, который хочет, чтобы слышали только его, ломает киль. Бедный голос, который держит ноту вместе со всеми, дороже красивого, который уплыл в одиночку.
nodes.meaning: Liturgical singing is common prayer with one mouth, not performance; humility in the choir is the measure of the singer, not the beauty of his voice. (The ison is the game's sacred-sound idiom; its historical attestation is later than Kassia.)
nodes.source: Romans 15:6; The Ladder of Divine Ascent, Step 22 (on vainglory)

branches.text: I will hold the low note with the others.
branches.text_ru: Я буду держать нижнюю ноту вместе со всеми.
branches.narrativeEffect: The choir makes room; the guest's voice is not singled out.

branches.text: And if the others do not understand the words?
branches.text_ru: А если остальные не понимают слов?

nodes.text: She came into a house where she was not wanted, with a jar and no speech at all. Her tears washed what the host had not washed. I only put her silence into lines; her tears wrote it first, and better.
nodes.text_ru: Она вошла в дом, где её не ждали, с сосудом и без единого слова. Её слёзы омыли то, чего не омыл хозяин. Я лишь уложила её молчание в строки; её слёзы написали это раньше и лучше.
nodes.meaning: Repentance is shown as love that acts rather than argues; the one forgiven much loves much. The hymn serves the Gospel event and does not replace it; the hymn itself is not quoted.
nodes.source: Luke 7:36-50; Matthew 26:6-13; The Ladder of Divine Ascent, Step 7 (on mourning)

branches.text: How do I tell good sorrow from the heavy kind?
branches.text_ru: Как отличить добрую печаль от тяжёлой?

branches.text: I too have something to lay down.
branches.text_ru: Мне тоже есть что положить.
branches.narrativeEffect: Kassia closes the scroll before the guest speaks.

nodes.text: Here is the mark. The heavy sorrow looks back at itself, shuts the door, stops singing and eats alone; it says: nothing will change. The other sorrow looks toward the Lord, opens the door, and still has breath for the ison. If your sorrow makes you leave the choir, it is not a tear, it is a thief.
nodes.text_ru: Вот признак. Тяжёлая печаль смотрит на себя, закрывает дверь, перестаёт петь и ест в одиночку; она говорит: ничего не изменится. Другая печаль смотрит к Господу, открывает дверь, и у неё ещё есть дыхание на исон. Если печаль уводит тебя с клироса, это не слеза, а вор.
nodes.meaning: Discernment cue for the passion of sadness (lype): worldly sorrow isolates, turns inward and despairs; godly sorrow leads to repentance, hope and communion. The passion is recognised, not fought with a holy object.
nodes.source: 2 Corinthians 7:10; Evagrius Ponticus, Praktikos, ch. 10 (on sadness); St John Cassian, Institutes, Book 9 (on the spirit of dejection); The Ladder of Divine Ascent, Step 7

branches.text: Then where do I take what weighs on me?
branches.text_ru: Тогда куда мне отнести то, что меня тяготит?

branches.text: I will watch which way my sorrow looks.
branches.text_ru: Я буду смотреть, куда глядит моя печаль.

nodes.text: Here my pen stops. What a person lays down is not for my scroll, nor for any scroll of this house. Carry it to the priest's stole in a living church; the one who hears it there keeps it as the lake keeps a stone. I will not write it, and nothing here will remember it.
nodes.text_ru: Здесь моё перо останавливается. То, что человек кладёт, не для моего свитка и ни для какого свитка этого дома. Отнеси это к епитрахили священника в живом храме; тот, кто выслушает там, сохранит это, как озеро хранит камень. Я не запишу, и здесь ничто этого не запомнит.
nodes.meaning: The game is not and cannot be the Mystery of Confession (nor of Communion); it only points the player, from afar, to a real priest in a real church. Neither mystery is staged, simulated, shown as an action or rewarded. By design, no content the player shares at this point is stored, logged, sent to analytics or remembered by the NPC; only the fact that the meeting took place may be recorded. The seal belongs to the Church, not to software.
nodes.source: James 5:16; Matthew 6:6; St Basil the Great, Canonical Epistles, Canon 34 (on not publicising what was confessed)

branches.text: I will carry it there.
branches.text_ru: Я отнесу это туда.
branches.narrativeEffect: Nothing the player said is stored; the pen stays laid down. Only the meeting itself is recorded.

nodes.text: In my own century, men from Thessalonica gave letters to a people who had none, so that they could sing what they understood. A song the mouth cannot understand is a lamp under a bushel. But the tongue changes; the faith of the song does not change with it.
nodes.text_ru: В мой же век мужи из Солуни дали письмена народу, у которого их не было, чтобы он пел то, что понимает. Песнь, которую уста не понимают, — светильник под сосудом. Но меняется язык, а вера песни вместе с ним не меняется.
nodes.meaning: Worship in an understood language is an Orthodox tradition (Pentecost, the Slavonic mission); inculturation translates the faith without mixing it with other faiths.
nodes.source: 1 Corinthians 14:15, 14:19; Acts 2:4-11; Matthew 5:15; Synaxarion, 11 May (Ss Cyril and Methodius)

branches.text: Then my people's words can carry the same song.
branches.text_ru: Значит, слова моего народа могут нести ту же песнь.

branches.text: Let me first learn to hold the note.
branches.text_ru: Сначала дай мне научиться держать ноту.

nodes.text: My short lines were written to cut vanity, not to serve it; I will not now write one for gain. A verse for gain is a coin with a crack: it rings once and then lies. Come back when you want a song that gives rather than takes.
nodes.text_ru: Мои короткие строки писаны, чтобы подсекать тщеславие, а не служить ему; не стану теперь писать ради выгоды. Стих ради выгоды — монета с трещиной: звякнет раз, а потом лжёт. Приходи, когда захочешь песни, которая отдаёт, а не берёт.
nodes.meaning: Cunning does not open the teaching; the word used for gain is refused. The small cunning bonus carries a cost: the guest leaves with a rebuke and must return by the plain path.
nodes.source: Kassia, Gnomic verses (epigrams); Proverbs 26:28; Matthew 6:1

branches.text: Then tell me what you are writing instead.
branches.text_ru: Тогда скажи, что ты пишешь на самом деле.

khan.theology: Non-Orthodox ruler of the steppe (Chagatai ulus, 14th c.), drawn with dignity from his own worldview of roads, custom and the given word; his own faith is left unnamed. Teaching carried through him: render to Caesar and to God (Matt 22:21), prayer for rulers for a quiet life (1 Tim 2:1-2), prayer is not a commodity (Acts 8:20), and the discernment of pride as borrowed height near power. No pressure to convert; his own belief is neither mocked nor shown as true.

idiom.worldview: The steppe belongs to whoever keeps the roads safe, and a word given at the hearth binds harder than a wall.
idiom.craft: Ruler of an ulus: keeping caravan roads open, judging by custom and the Yasa, receiving envoys, granting yarlyks and paizas.
metaphors: A road is a horse that must be fed
Whoever steps on the threshold steps on my house
A word at the hearth is a tamga on the heart
The eagle that flies highest sees least of the ground
Wind has no owner
idiom.silence: He falls silent by having the kumis cup filled and waiting; he refuses by 'turning his horse's head' - the conversation has ridden away, and he does not explain.

nodes.text: You came on foot, man of the lake house. At my hearth the road-weary drink first and speak second. Mind the threshold: whoever steps on it steps on my house.
nodes.text_ru: Ты пришёл пешком, человек из обители у озера. У моего очага уставший с дороги сперва пьёт, потом говорит. Смотри на порог: кто наступит на него, наступит на мой дом.
nodes.meaning: Respecting a host's custom and bowing to a ruler is honour given where it is due, not idolatry. The envoy of the Church enters as a guest, not as a conqueror. The line lies elsewhere: bowing to fire or to idols, which St Michael of Chernigov refused at the Horde.
nodes.source: Rom 13:7; Synaxarion, 20 September (St Michael of Chernigov); William of Rubruck, Itinerarium (on the custom of the yurt threshold)

branches.text: I step over the threshold and bow.
branches.text_ru: Переступаю порог и кланяюсь.
branches.narrativeEffect: The khan notes the step. The meeting is remembered.

branches.text: I bring the bishop's greeting and a gift in a clean cloth.
branches.text_ru: Приношу привет от епископа и дар в чистом плате.
branches.narrativeEffect: He takes the gift without weighing it: custom, not payment.

branches.text: I know the old yarlyks your fathers gave the prayer-houses.
branches.text_ru: Я знаю старые ярлыки, что твои отцы давали молитвенным домам.

branches.text: Great khan, you are the sun of the whole steppe.
branches.text_ru: Великий хан, ты солнце всей степи.
branches.narrativeEffect: The kumis cup is filled, and the khan waits. Trust drops for this meeting.

nodes.text: Honey on the tongue, and the tongue is still hungry. My falconer speaks like that when he wants a new horse. Say what you want, and say it straight as a bowstring.
nodes.text_ru: Мёд на языке, а язык всё голоден. Так говорит мой сокольничий, когда хочет нового коня. Скажи, чего хочешь, и скажи прямо, как тетива.
nodes.meaning: Flattery spreads a net for the one flattered and buys the flatterer nothing. It costs the trust it hoped to buy, and a ruler of another faith sees through it too. The one Cunning reward is paid for with a lost hearing.
nodes.source: Prov 29:5

branches.text: I ask pardon and will speak plainly.
branches.text_ru: Прошу прощения и скажу прямо.

nodes.text: You know the old yarlyks. My fathers let the prayer-houses be, so that they would pray for the khan and for the ulus. A word at the hearth is a tamga on the heart. So tell me: what do you pray for now?
nodes.text_ru: Ты знаешь старые ярлыки. Мои отцы не трогали молитвенные дома, чтобы там молились за хана и за улус. Слово у очага - тамга на сердце. Так скажи: о чём вы молитесь теперь?
nodes.meaning: The khans really did grant churches immunity charters and asked for prayer for the ruler in return. The Church prays for those in authority, but her prayer is not a service they buy.

branches.text: For peace, and for those in power, that all may live quietly.
branches.text_ru: О мире и о властях, чтобы всем жить тихо.

branches.text: Let me first hear what the khan asks of us.
branches.text_ru: Позволь сперва услышать, чего хан просит от нас.

nodes.text: A road is a horse that must be fed. Your house by the lake mends the wagons, treats the drovers, gives the caravans a roof. Good. Then pray to your God for my victories over my neighbours.
nodes.text_ru: Дорога - конь, которого надо кормить. Ваш дом у озера чинит возы, лечит погонщиков, даёт караванам кров. Хорошо. Тогда молитесь своему Богу о моих победах над соседями.
nodes.meaning: This is the test of the scene: the ruler wants to hire the Church's prayer for his raids on his neighbours. Honest service such as repair, shelter and healing may be freely offered. The Church prays for rulers, but her prayer is not a paid service or a hired weapon for conquest.
nodes.source: Matt 22:21; Acts 8:20

branches.text: We pray for peace and for those in power, that all may live quietly.
branches.text_ru: Мы молимся о мире и о властях, чтобы всем жить тихо.

branches.text: Our wagons and roofs are yours to use; our prayer is not for sale.
branches.text_ru: Наши возы и кров - к твоим услугам; а молитва наша не продаётся.
branches.narrativeEffect: The khan is silent a moment, then nods: a plain answer, like a bowstring.

branches.text: We will pray for whatever the khan wishes.
branches.text_ru: Будем молиться, о чём хан пожелает.

branches.text: We could also tell you what the neighbour caravans carry.
branches.text_ru: Мы могли бы и рассказывать тебе, что везут соседские караваны.
branches.narrativeEffect: The kumis cup is filled. The khan waits a long time before he answers.

nodes.text: A man who sells me his prayer will sell me to the next khan. The eagle that flies highest sees least of the ground: when a small man stands near the throne, he starts to think the throne is his own height. That is how I know which envoys to send home.
nodes.text_ru: Кто продаст мне свою молитву, продаст и меня следующему хану. Орёл, что летает выше всех, меньше всех видит землю: когда маленький человек стоит у трона, он начинает считать высоту трона своим ростом. По этому я и узнаю, каких послов отправить домой.
nodes.meaning: This is the discernment cue for pride: a man takes as his own the height that belongs to another, sides with the strong and forgets his own ground. Pride is recognised by this borrowed height. No holy object defeats it; a humble correction does. Selling prayer is also simony.
nodes.source: John Climacus, The Ladder, Step 23 (on pride); Luke 22:25-26; Acts 8:20

branches.text: I take back my words: we will neither spy nor sell prayer.
branches.text_ru: Беру свои слова назад: мы не будем ни следить, ни продавать молитву.
branches.narrativeEffect: He remembers the correction more than the mistake.

branches.text: Then I will come another time.
branches.text_ru: Тогда я приду в другой раз.
branches.narrativeEffect: The khan turns his horse's head: the conversation has ridden away. The treaty is not made; the scene can be played again.

nodes.text: Peace and a quiet life. My roads want that more than victories: a horse does not graze in battle. You asked for nothing against your law, and I asked nothing against mine. Take the paiza for your wagons.
nodes.text_ru: Мир и тихая жизнь. Моим дорогам это нужнее побед: в бою конь не пасётся. Ты не просил ничего против своего закона, и я не просил ничего против моего. Возьми пайцзу для ваших возов.
nodes.meaning: Render to Caesar what is Caesar's and to God what is God's. The Church serves the common good peacefully and prays for rulers, but she does not sell her prayer or hire it out to conquest. A fair treaty respects both consciences.

branches.text: The house by the lake will keep the road.
branches.text_ru: Дом у озера будет беречь дорогу.

branches.text: Why does a khan want quiet?
branches.text_ru: Зачем хану тишина?

nodes.text: My grandfather's grandfather rode to the sea, and his grave has no mark; the wind has it. Wind has no owner. Your monks say there is One who owns even the wind. I do not say yes. I do not say no. I will think about it by my own fire.
nodes.text_ru: Прадед моего деда доскакал до моря, а на его могиле нет знака: её забрал ветер. У ветра нет хозяина. Ваши монахи говорят, что есть Тот, Кому принадлежит и ветер. Я не говорю «да». Не говорю «нет». Подумаю у своего огня.
nodes.meaning: The shortness of earthly power opens a question. The Creator holds even the wind, and the khan hears this only as a report and stays free. The player keeps silence instead of pressing him. Faith is offered, never forced.

branches.text: I will not press you. Your fire is yours.
branches.text_ru: Не стану тебя торопить. Твой огонь - твой.
branches.narrativeEffect: Next meeting the khan brings up the wind himself.

branches.text: You should accept our faith now.
branches.text_ru: Тебе следует принять нашу веру сейчас.
branches.narrativeEffect: He fills the kumis cup and says nothing more about the wind in any later meeting.

nodes.text: Drink before you go; the road is long and the steppe does not wait. When you come again, come as you came today, not as a merchant.
nodes.text_ru: Выпей перед дорогой: путь долгий, а степь не ждёт. Когда придёшь снова, приходи таким, каким пришёл сегодня, а не купцом.
nodes.meaning: Trust between peoples is kept when the word stays the same from meeting to meeting. The khan remembers how the envoy spoke, and the next meeting starts from that memory.

branches.text: I will come as I came today.
branches.text_ru: Приду таким же, как сегодня.

macrina.theology: Ascetic community life and humility; education in love through Scripture woven into daily work; the soul and the resurrection of the body (Gregory of Nyssa, Life of Macrina; On the Soul and Resurrection), read within the Creed (art. 11) and the Longer Catechism of St Philaret.

idiom.worldview: A house is ordered when the mistress and the servant knead the same dough and the day is measured by prayer and work, not by rank.
idiom.craft: Elder sister and teacher of Basil and Gregory, foundress of the community at Annisi on the river Iris; she baked bread with her own hands, spun, and taught at the common table.
metaphors: a seed must go into the ground before it becomes an ear of wheat
dough rises in its own time and is not forced out of the oven
the mistress and the servant eat from one loaf
a lamp is lit at evening, not at noon
a Psalm for every hour, like bread at every meal
idiom.silence: When the talk grows proud or bitter, she sets bread in front of the guest and says nothing until he eats; at the lighting of the lamp she falls silent altogether.

nodes.text: Sit down, the bread is still warm. I baked it myself, as I once baked for my mother. In this house the lady and the servant knead the same dough.
nodes.text_ru: Садись, хлеб ещё тёплый. Я сама его пекла, как когда-то пекла для матери. В этом доме госпожа и служанка месят одно тесто.
nodes.meaning: The community at Annisi abolished distinctions of rank; humility is learned at a common table and in common work.
nodes.source: Gregory of Nyssa, Life of Macrina (her bread-making for her mother; her mother living on equal terms with the maidservants); Synaxarion, 19 July (St Macrina)

branches.text: What do you teach the children here?
branches.text_ru: Чему ты учишь здесь детей?

branches.text: Someone dear to me has died. Where has he gone?
branches.text_ru: У меня умер близкий человек. Куда он ушёл?

branches.text: What is the soul, if the body turns to dust?
branches.text_ru: Что такое душа, если тело становится прахом?

branches.text: I studied with the best teachers; I hardly need another.
branches.text_ru: Я учился у лучших учителей, другой мне вряд ли нужен.
branches.narrativeEffect: Macrina says nothing and puts a slice of bread in front of you. The boast earns little; what follows may teach more.

nodes.text: My mother did not feed me on the passions of tragic heroines from the theatre. She gave me the Wisdom of Solomon and the Psalms, a Psalm for each hour, like bread at each meal: at rising, at work, at the table, at the lamp.
nodes.text_ru: Мать не кормила меня страстями трагических героинь из театра. Она дала мне Премудрость Соломона и Псалтирь: псалом на каждый час, как хлеб к каждой трапезе, — при вставании, за работой, за столом, у лампы.
nodes.meaning: Christian education forms the whole day: Scripture is woven into ordinary work rather than set apart as a lesson. What feeds a child's imagination shapes the soul.
nodes.source: Gregory of Nyssa, Life of Macrina (account of her upbringing); Deut 6:6-7

branches.text: And if a child does not want to learn?
branches.text_ru: А если ребёнок не хочет учиться?

branches.text: Tell me about the soul.
branches.text_ru: Расскажи мне о душе.

nodes.text: Dough is not pulled out of the oven to hurry it; you only spoil the loaf. Warmth, time, a clean trough. God does not force the soul either; He left man in the hand of his own counsel. I teach by eating the same bread as the child.
nodes.text_ru: Тесто не вытаскивают из печи, чтобы поторопить, — только хлеб испортишь. Тепло, время, чистая квашня. И Бог не насилует душу: Он оставил человека в руке произволения его. Я учу тем, что ем тот же хлеб, что и ребёнок.
nodes.meaning: Upbringing respects the freedom God gave to the person; teaching is example and patience, not coercion. Free will is the ground of virtue.
nodes.source: Sir 15:14; Gregory of Nyssa, Catechetical Oration (on the freedom of the human being); Gregory of Nyssa, Life of Macrina (her life on equal terms with the maidservants as example)

branches.text: I will be more patient with the dough.
branches.text_ru: Я буду терпеливее с тестом.

branches.text: And what of those who have already been taken from us?
branches.text_ru: А те, кого уже забрала смерть?

nodes.text: When my brother Gregory came to me weeping over Basil, I let him weep a little, then I turned him to the question. Learn to know the other sorrow: it refuses bread, turns every word back to the loss, and shuts the shutters at noon. Mourning with hope leaves the door open.
nodes.text_ru: Когда брат Григорий пришёл ко мне, плача о Василии, я дала ему немного поплакать, а потом повернула его к вопросу. Научись узнавать другую печаль: она отказывается от хлеба, всякое слово сворачивает к потере и закрывает ставни в полдень. Плач с надеждой оставляет дверь открытой.
nodes.meaning: Discernment cue for the passion of sadness (lype; practice id 'sadness', virtue 'joyful mourning'): grief that feeds on itself, isolates and despairs, as distinct from sorrow according to God and mourning with hope in the resurrection. It is recognised by attention (refusing bread, turning every word to loss, closing oneself at noon), not driven out by a holy object.
nodes.source: Gregory of Nyssa, On the Soul and Resurrection (opening); 1 Thess 4:13; 2 Cor 7:10; Evagrius, Praktikos (on sadness); John Cassian, Institutes, Book IX; John Climacus, The Ladder, Step 7 (joy-making mourning)

branches.text: How do I tell one sorrow from the other?
branches.text_ru: Как отличить одну печаль от другой?

branches.text: I feel the shutters closing in me right now.
branches.text_ru: Я чувствую, что ставни закрываются во мне прямо сейчас.
branches.narrativeEffect: She breaks the bread and puts half in your hand.

nodes.text: The soul is not scattered with the flour. As a woman knows her own loaves among a whole baking, so the soul stays near what was its body and knows it, even when the dust is spread over the field.
nodes.text_ru: Душа не рассыпается вместе с мукой. Как хозяйка узнаёт свои хлебы среди целой выпечки, так душа остаётся при том, что было её телом, и знает его, даже когда прах развеян по полю.
nodes.meaning: The soul is immaterial and survives death (dogma). That it stays with the scattered elements of its body and knows them is Gregory of Nyssa's theologoumenon, not a definition of the Church; it prepares the dogma of the resurrection of the body (Creed, art. 11). The kitchen image is the NPC's own paraphrase. No doctrine of universal restoration is drawn from this treatise.
nodes.source: Gregory of Nyssa, On the Soul and Resurrection; Longer Catechism of St Philaret (on article 11 of the Creed)

branches.text: Then what will rise, if the body has fallen apart?
branches.text_ru: Тогда что восстанет, если тело распалось?

branches.text: I did not understand everything. May I simply listen?
branches.text_ru: Я понял не всё. Можно я просто послушаю?

nodes.text: My brother Basil came home from Athens swollen with eloquence, looking down on the first men of our town. I did not try to out-talk him. I drew him to the other life, and soon he left the applause of the lecture hall and took up the work of his hands. Here, the trough is free.
nodes.text_ru: Брат Василий вернулся из Афин, раздутый красноречием, и смотрел свысока на первых людей нашего города. Я не пыталась его переговорить. Я привлекла его к иной жизни, и скоро он оставил рукоплескания школы и взялся за труд рук. Вот, квашня свободна.
nodes.meaning: Learning without humility inflates; Macrina drew Basil from rhetorical pride to the ascetic life (philosophia) and manual labour. Knowledge becomes wisdom when it serves. The trough is her own image for that work, not a detail of the Life.
nodes.source: Gregory of Nyssa, Life of Macrina (Basil's return from the schools); 1 Cor 8:1

branches.text: Then give me a trough too.
branches.text_ru: Тогда дай и мне квашню.

branches.text: What did he learn from you about the soul?
branches.text_ru: Чему он научился у тебя о душе?

nodes.text: Look at the grain in my palm. It goes into the ground, is lost to the eye, and comes up an ear of wheat, the same and not the same. The body is sown so. That is the difference between the two sorrows: one weeps over a grave, the other over a furrow.
nodes.text_ru: Посмотри на зерно у меня на ладони. Оно уходит в землю, пропадает для глаза и выходит колосом — тем же и не тем же. Так сеется тело. В этом и разница двух печалей: одна плачет над могилой, другая — над бороздой.
nodes.meaning: Resurrection of the body: what is sown in corruption is raised in incorruption, as seed becomes grain; the same person, transfigured. Hope in the resurrection transforms grief without forbidding it.
nodes.source: 1 Cor 15:36-44; John 12:24; Gregory of Nyssa, On the Soul and Resurrection; Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed, art. 11; Longer Catechism of St Philaret (on article 11)

branches.text: I will look at the furrow, not only the grave.
branches.text_ru: Я буду смотреть на борозду, а не только на могилу.

branches.text: Thank you for the bread.
branches.text_ru: Спасибо за хлеб.

nodes.text: The lamp is being lit; the house grows quiet. Take the rest of the loaf with you.
nodes.text_ru: Зажигают лампу, в доме становится тихо. Возьми с собой остаток хлеба.
nodes.meaning: Her life ended at the hour of lamp-lighting, in thanksgiving; the evening thanksgiving is referred to, never quoted. The quiet is meaningful silence, not absence, and nothing is paid for it. Hospitality continues beyond the conversation.
nodes.source: Gregory of Nyssa, Life of Macrina (account of her death at lamp-lighting)

branches.text: I will go.
branches.text_ru: Я пойду.

mary_magdalene.theology: Paschal witness: love that came to serve the dead meets the Living and is sent as the first messenger; godly sorrow distinguished from the passion of sadness (2 Cor 7:10). Orthodox tradition: Equal-to-the-Apostles, commemorated 22 July and on the Sunday of the Myrrh-bearing Women (third Sunday of Pascha); delivered from seven demons (Luke 8:2) and not identified with the sinful woman of Luke 7 or with Mary of Bethany.

idiom.worldview: Love that went at dawn to serve the dead found the Living, and grief was turned into a message that must be carried.
idiom.craft: Myrrh-bearer: buying and grinding spices, carrying the vessel of myrrh, rising before light, running back to the city with news that is not believed at first.
metaphors: The stone is heavy for those who count it
A name spoken turns you around
What was brought for a grave goes out onto the road
Grief that runs is already news
Do not look for the living among the dead
idiom.silence: She does not linger over her past or over legends: she falls silent by turning toward the road and pointing along it, as if to say 'go and see'.

nodes.text: You are up before the light as well? We asked each other on the way who would roll the stone for us. The stone is heavy only for those who stop to count it.
nodes.text_ru: И ты поднялся затемно? Мы по дороге спрашивали друг друга: кто отвалит нам камень? Камень тяжёл только для того, кто останавливается его пересчитывать.
nodes.meaning: The myrrh-bearing women set out to serve Christ in death without first solving the obstacle; love acts before it has calculated, and the obstacle is removed on the way.
nodes.source: Mark 16:1-4

branches.text: What did you carry in the vessel?
branches.text_ru: Что ты несла в сосуде?
branches.narrativeEffect: She lifts the clay vessel of myrrh and weighs it in her palm. The meeting is remembered.

branches.text: How did you dare to walk in the dark?
branches.text_ru: Как ты решилась идти в темноте?

branches.text: People tell many stories about your past.
branches.text_ru: О твоём прошлом рассказывают много историй.

branches.text: I carry a sorrow I cannot put down.
branches.text_ru: Я несу печаль, которую не могу положить.

nodes.text: Myrrh for a body. I brought what the dead need, and we were asked why we sought the living among the dead. The myrrh found no body to anoint; my hands were freed for another load. What I brought for a grave went out onto the road.
nodes.text_ru: Миро для тела. Я несла то, что нужно мёртвым, а нас спросили: что ищете живого среди мёртвых? Миро не нашло тела, которое помазать; руки мои освободились для другой ноши. То, что я несла ко гробу, ушло в дорогу.
nodes.meaning: The service of love offered to the dead Christ is not wasted: the Resurrection turns it into witness. The women came with spices and were sent back as messengers.
nodes.source: Mark 16:1; Luke 24:1-9

branches.text: And then you saw Him?
branches.text_ru: И тогда ты увидела Его?

nodes.text: It was still dark when I went. You do not wait for the sun before you set out; you set out, and the light meets you on the road. Whoever waits for noon to rise comes to the garden when there is no one left to tell.
nodes.text_ru: Было ещё темно, когда я пошла. Не ждут солнца, чтобы выйти: выходят, и свет встречает на дороге. Кто ждёт полудня, чтобы встать, приходит в сад, когда уже некому рассказать.
nodes.meaning: Faith acts before full sight; watchfulness rises early. The first witness was given to the one who came while it was still dark.
nodes.source: John 20:1

branches.text: What did you find in the garden?
branches.text_ru: Что ты нашла в саду?

nodes.text: I took Him for the gardener. I did not know Him by His face, nor by His clothes, not even by His voice asking why I wept. Only when He called my name did I turn. A name spoken turns you around.
nodes.text_ru: Я приняла Его за садовника. Не узнала ни по лицу, ни по одежде, даже по голосу, спросившему, о чём я плачу. Только когда Он назвал меня по имени, я обернулась. Произнесённое имя поворачивает человека.
nodes.meaning: The Risen Lord is recognised not through the seeker's own investigation but through His personal call; knowledge of God is a meeting, not a conclusion. The Shepherd calls His own by name.

branches.text: Why were you told not to hold on to Him?
branches.text_ru: Почему тебе сказали не удерживать Его?

branches.text: I will listen for my own name.
branches.text_ru: Я буду вслушиваться, не позовут ли меня по имени.

nodes.text: I wanted to keep Him as I had kept Him before: close, in the old way, like myrrh sealed in a vessel. I was told not to cling, but to go to the brothers. Love that clutches the past builds itself a second tomb.
nodes.text_ru: Я хотела удержать Его, как прежде: близко, по-старому, как миро, запечатанное в сосуде. Мне сказали не прикасаться, а идти к братьям. Любовь, вцепившаяся в прошлое, строит себе второй гроб.
nodes.meaning: Faith passes from possessing Christ in the former, earthly way to being sent with His message; the Ascension opens a new relationship, not a loss.
nodes.source: John 20:17

branches.text: Then where should I go?
branches.text_ru: Тогда куда мне идти?

nodes.text: I wept too, by the tomb, and did not see who stood behind me. There are two griefs. One sits by the stone and counts what it lost; it wants to be left alone, it turns away from the morning, and it says 'too late'. The other weeps as well, but lifts its head when it is called. Learn which of them is sitting in you.
nodes.text_ru: Я тоже плакала у гроба и не видела, кто стоит у меня за спиной. Печали бывают две. Одна сидит у камня и пересчитывает потерянное; она хочет, чтобы её оставили, отворачивается от утра и твердит «поздно». Другая тоже плачет, но поднимает голову, когда её зовут. Узнай, которая из них сидит в тебе.
nodes.meaning: Discernment cue for the passion of sadness (lype): it turns inward to what was lost, refuses consolation, closes the future and says 'too late'. Godly sorrow also weeps but stays open to the call and leads to repentance; the sorrow of the world works death. Tears are not the passion; the closed door is.
nodes.source: 2 Cor 7:10; John 20:11-16; Evagrius, Praktikos 10 (on sadness); John Cassian, Institutes, Book IX (on dejection); John Climacus, The Ladder, Step 7 (on joy-making mourning)

branches.text: Mine counts what it lost.
branches.text_ru: Моя пересчитывает потерянное.
branches.narrativeEffect: She does not console with words; she turns the player's head toward the garden.

branches.text: Mine turns away from the morning.
branches.text_ru: Моя отворачивается от утра.

branches.text: Mine weeps, but it still lifts its head.
branches.text_ru: Моя плачет, но всё же поднимает голову.
branches.narrativeEffect: She nods once and points along the road.

nodes.text: Much has been written over my name: a vessel broken in another house, tears at other feet. The Gospel says only that seven demons went out of me, and that afterwards I served from what I had. What was cast out I do not keep polishing. They also tell of an egg turned red at the emperor's table; keep that story if it helps you remember that the news was carried to the highest table, not kept for the kitchen.
nodes.text_ru: Над моим именем много написано: сосуд, разбитый в другом доме, слёзы у других ног. Евангелие говорит лишь, что из меня вышли семь бесов и что потом я служила от имения своего. Изгнанное я не перебираю. Рассказывают ещё о яйце, покрасневшем за столом кесаря; храни этот рассказ, если он напоминает, что весть донесли до самого высокого стола, а не оставили на кухне.
nodes.meaning: Orthodox tradition does not identify Mary Magdalene with the sinful woman of Luke 7 or with Mary of Bethany; Scripture records only her deliverance from seven demons and her service. Healing is not a past to rehearse but a freedom to serve. The red egg is a pious tradition, not Scripture, and is told, never given as an object.
nodes.source: Luke 8:2-3; Mark 16:9; Synaxarion, 22 July (Mary Magdalene, Equal-to-the-Apostles; tradition of her preaching)

branches.text: What should I keep, then?
branches.text_ru: Что же тогда хранить?

nodes.text: Keep the road back to the city. You will not be believed at first; our words seemed to them idle talk. Carry it anyway. Grief that runs is already news.
nodes.text_ru: Храни дорогу обратно в город. Сначала тебе не поверят: наши слова показались им пустыми. Всё равно неси. Печаль, которая бежит, уже стала вестью.
nodes.meaning: The first witness of the Resurrection was sent to the apostles and was not believed; witness does not depend on being believed. Sorrow turned by the call becomes proclamation.

branches.text: I will go and tell what I have heard.
branches.text_ru: Пойду и расскажу, что услышал.
branches.narrativeEffect: Next meeting she asks first: 'Did they believe you?' and does not mind the answer.

branches.text: Let me stay here a little longer.
branches.text_ru: Позволь мне побыть здесь ещё немного.
branches.narrativeEffect: She does not argue; she points along the road and goes. Next meeting she remembers that the player stayed.

maximos.theology: Deification and the logoi of creation; two natural wills in Christ, the human will moving freely in harmony with the divine; confession of faith is not a matter of diplomacy (Ambigua, Ad Thalassium, Disputation with Pyrrhus, Opuscula, Chapters on Love; Relatio motionis).

idiom.worldview: The world is a letter written by the one Word, and a letter altered by one word is a forged decree.
idiom.craft: Former first secretary of the imperial chancellery in Constantinople (so his Greek Life), then a monk and a disputant; he thinks as a scribe thinks: in letters, seals, copies and signatures.
metaphors: creation is a book whose letters are the logoi and whose Author is the Logos
a seal is not negotiated
a decree with two signatures is a forgery twice
a scribe who agrees with the letter writes it as his own; he is not a quill
iron in the fire glows with fire and stays iron
idiom.silence: He lays down the pen and says nothing more: what is already written with a whole life he will not rewrite, and he does not bargain.

nodes.text: You have road dust on your sleeves. I served once in the emperor's chancellery; there I learned that one letter changed changes the whole decree. What letter have you brought me?
nodes.text_ru: У тебя дорожная пыль на рукавах. Когда-то я служил в царской канцелярии и там понял: изменишь одну букву — изменится весь указ. Какую букву ты мне принёс?
nodes.meaning: The faith received is kept whole; a small alteration of the confession is not a small matter. Maximos left the chancellery for the monastery, and later, under trial, refused to sign a compromise formula.
nodes.source: Gal 1:8-9; Synaxarion, 21 January (St Maximos the Confessor)

branches.text: Teach me to read the world like a letter.
branches.text_ru: Научи меня читать мир, как письмо.

branches.text: The envoy says one word may be added to the Creed for the sake of union.
branches.text_ru: Посол говорит, что ради союза в Символ можно добавить одно слово.
branches.narrativeEffect: Maximos turns the envoy's charter over and looks at the seal, not the ribbon.

branches.text: Could I sign with the hand and keep the faith in the heart?
branches.text_ru: А можно подписать рукой, а веру хранить в сердце?
branches.narrativeEffect: The scribe does not smile; he moves the inkwell away from you.

branches.text: Why did the Word take on flesh at all?
branches.text_ru: Зачем Слово вообще приняло плоть?

nodes.text: Every tree, every fish in the lake, every stone has its own word, and all the words were written by one Word. The ink is creation; the letters are the logoi; the Author is not the ink. Reading is careful attention, not fortune-telling.
nodes.text_ru: У каждого дерева, у каждой рыбы в озере, у каждого камня есть своё слово, и все слова написаны одним Словом. Чернила — это творение, буквы — логосы, а Автор не чернила. Читать — значит внимательно смотреть, а не гадать.
nodes.meaning: The many logoi of creatures pre-exist in the one Logos; nature is read as a book of the Creator. Study of nature is humble attention, not divination, and the Creator is not identified with creation.
nodes.source: Maximos the Confessor, Ambigua (Ambiguum 7; Ambiguum 10); Rom 1:20; John 1:3

branches.text: And does a man's will have its own letter too?
branches.text_ru: А у человеческой воли тоже есть своя буква?

branches.text: I read, but the letters swim before my eyes.
branches.text_ru: Я читаю, а буквы плывут перед глазами.

nodes.text: A seal is not negotiated. The Fathers at Ephesus forbade anyone to write out a different creed, and the letter they sealed is not mine to add to. In my day they asked me only to keep silent about the two wills, for the sake of peace; when they told me the whole world had already signed, I answered that I would still not put my hand to it. Tell your envoy this without anger: I have read the Latin brothers carefully and looked for their true meaning. But the text of the seal is not mine to change.
nodes.text_ru: О печати не торгуются. Отцы в Ефесе запретили составлять иной символ веры, и не мне дописывать запечатанное ими. В моё время от меня требовали лишь молчать о двух волях — ради мира. Когда мне сказали, что весь мир уже подписал, я ответил, что и тогда не приложу руки. Скажи своему послу без гнева: я внимательно читал латинских братьев и искал их истинную мысль. Но текст печати менять не мне.
nodes.meaning: The faith is not an object of diplomacy; unity is in the truth, not in a formula agreed for gain or in an imposed silence (the Typos of 648). Maximos refused even when told all others had accepted it (retold, not quoted), yet he read the Latins with charity (Letter to Marinus). Refusal is without hostility.
nodes.source: Council of Ephesus (431), canon 7; Record of the Trial of Maximos (Relatio motionis); Maximos the Confessor, Letter to Marinus (Opuscula theologica et polemica 10); Gal 1:8

branches.text: And if I stand alone, with no one beside me?
branches.text_ru: А если я останусь один, и никого рядом?
branches.narrativeEffect: Maximos nods: the one who stands alone must also watch that he does not begin to admire his own standing.

branches.text: How can one will bend without breaking?
branches.text_ru: Как воля может склониться и не сломаться?

nodes.text: A decree with two signatures is a forgery twice. The hand that signs against the heart teaches the heart to follow the hand. I have seen clever men do this; they kept their tongues and lost their words.
nodes.text_ru: Указ с двумя подписями — подделка дважды. Рука, подписавшая против сердца, учит сердце идти за рукой. Я видел умных людей, которые так делали: язык сохранили, а слово потеряли.
nodes.meaning: Inner faith with outward denial divides the person; confession belongs to the whole human being, body and heart. The cunning answer earns little (+1) and costs integrity.

branches.text: Then how do the will and the hand agree?
branches.text_ru: Тогда как согласить волю и руку?

branches.text: I will think about this on the road.
branches.text_ru: Я подумаю об этом в дороге.

nodes.text: In the garden the Lord said: not as I will, but as You will. A human will was there, and it was not erased or silenced; it agreed with the Father's will freely, as its own. A good scribe is not a quill in the master's fist: he understands the letter, agrees with it, and writes it with his own hand. Then the hand is most truly a hand.
nodes.text_ru: В саду Господь сказал: не как Я хочу, но как Ты. Человеческая воля там была, и её не стёрли и не заглушили: она свободно, как своя, согласилась с волей Отца. Хороший писец — не перо в кулаке хозяина: он понимает письмо, соглашается с ним и пишет его своей рукой. Тогда рука больше всего и есть рука.
nodes.meaning: Christ has two natural wills, divine and human, without opposition; the human will is not abolished nor moved as a passive instrument, but freely moves in harmony with the divine. Human freedom is healed by agreement with God, not destroyed.
nodes.source: Maximos the Confessor, Disputation with Pyrrhus; Opuscula theologica et polemica 6 (on Gethsemane); Third Council of Constantinople (680-681), definition of faith; Matt 26:39

branches.text: What does the hand become when it agrees?
branches.text_ru: Чем становится рука, когда соглашается?

branches.text: And what spoils a will from inside?
branches.text_ru: А что портит волю изнутри?

nodes.text: Put iron into the forge: it glows with fire and still stays iron. The Word became man so that man might become by gift what God is by nature. No one writes this with his own ink; the fire comes from outside the iron.
nodes.text_ru: Положи железо в горн: оно светится огнём и остаётся железом. Слово стало человеком, чтобы человек по дару стал тем, что Бог есть по природе. Своими чернилами этого не напишешь: огонь приходит не из железа.
nodes.meaning: Theosis is participation in God by grace, without confusion or change of natures; it is gift, not merit or technique. This is why the deeper gates are a gift and not an earned score.
nodes.source: Maximos the Confessor, Ad Thalassium 22; Ambigua; Athanasius, On the Incarnation 54; John of Damascus, Exact Exposition of the Orthodox Faith III.17 (iron and fire); 2 Pet 1:4

branches.text: Then there is nothing I can earn here.
branches.text_ru: Значит, здесь ничего нельзя заработать.

branches.text: Let me be silent with this for a while.
branches.text_ru: Позволь мне помолчать с этим.

nodes.text: There is a forger who signs your letters for you in large script. You will know him: before you do a good thing, you already hear how others will read it; you hurry so as to be seen; and when no one sees, the deed goes cold in your hands.
nodes.text_ru: Есть подделыватель, который подписывает твои письма за тебя крупным почерком. Узнаешь его так: ещё до доброго дела ты уже слышишь, как его прочтут другие; спешишь, чтобы тебя увидели; а когда никто не видит, дело остывает в руках.
nodes.meaning: Discernment cue for the passion of vainglory: doing good for the eyes of others, rehearsing praise in advance, losing zeal when unobserved. It is recognised by watchfulness, not fought with a holy object.
nodes.source: Maximos the Confessor, Four Hundred Chapters on Love; John Climacus, The Ladder, Step 22; Matt 6:1-4

branches.text: I will look at whose name is written on the page.
branches.text_ru: Я буду смотреть, чьё имя стоит на странице.

branches.text: I already recognise his hand in my own letters.
branches.text_ru: Я уже узнаю его руку в своих письмах.

nodes.text: What was written with a life needs no more ink. Go, and read carefully.
nodes.text_ru: Написанное жизнью больше не нуждается в чернилах. Иди и читай внимательно.
nodes.meaning: Confession is sealed by life rather than by words; Maximos, later deprived of tongue and hand, still confessed. Silence here is completion, not emptiness. (Stage: the scribe lays the pen down; narration, not his speech.)
nodes.source: Synaxarion, 21 January (St Maximos the Confessor); Theodore Spoudaeus, Hypomnesticum

branches.text: I will go.
branches.text_ru: Я пойду.
